reason: The README describes a plugin marketplace catalog search and recommendation tool with category filtering, detail lookup, ranking, and optional HTTPS catalog refresh.

summaries.zh: 根据需求描述、分类和标签搜索、筛选并推荐 DeepSeek Harness 插件市场中的插件。
summaries.en: Search, filter, and recommend DeepSeek Harness plugins from a marketplace catalog using need descriptions, categories, and tags.

capabilities: Searches and ranks entries in an embedded plugin marketplace catalog
Filters results by category and returns plugin details
Fetches an updated catalog from an external README over HTTPS
